latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the setup-agent-wallet skill for Uniswap agents.

- Supports provisioning agent wallets using Privy, Turnkey, or Safe, with clear guidance for provider selection.
- Extracts key parameters (provider, chains, environment, spending limits) from user input, with sensible defaults.
- Delegates full wallet lifecycle (provision, configure, fund, validate) to the wallet-provisioner agent.
- Returns a clear wallet setup summary to the user on success.
- Provides user-friendly error handling and suggested actions for common setup issues.
